zcashPending.body: Login with Zcash signs a challenge with your wallet key, so it stays in ZUULI until the cross-surface bridge ships. Use a password or a linked account here.
zcashPending.title: Zcash login is not on this surface yet

chat.installHint: Don't have e2e2z yet? “Open e2e2z” takes you to its install page.

confirm.title: Start an encrypted chat with @{username}
confirm.body: {cost}, paid to @{username}. Messages are end-to-end encrypted in the e2e2z app.
confirm.noAutoSend: e2e2z opens with @{username} filled in. Nothing is sent until you write it.
confirm.priceError: The price could not be loaded, so nothing was charged.

action.openFailed: free2z couldn't open e2e2z. Get it from the install page, then try again.

connected.title: Chat ready with @{username}
connected.body: {charged} paid to @{username}. Open e2e2z to write your first message. Nothing is sent until you do.

awaitingHandle.title: @{username} has been notified
awaitingHandle.body: {charged} paid to @{username}. They need to claim a messaging handle in e2e2z before a chat can open, so there is no link to follow yet.

insufficient.title: Not enough 2Z
insufficient.body: Starting a chat costs {cost}, and nothing was charged. Your balance is {balance}.

notFound.title: @{username} can't be found
notFound.body: free2z has no account at @{username}, so nothing was charged.

self.title: This is your own profile
self.body: A chat request goes to someone else. Open e2e2z to see your own messages.

rateLimited.title: Too many chat requests
rateLimited.body: free2z asked you to slow down, so nothing was charged. Wait a minute, then try again.

signedOut.title: Sign in again
signedOut.body: Your free2z session ended before the request was accepted, so nothing was charged.

refused.title: free2z refused this request
refused.body: Check your 2Z balance before you try again.

mismatch.title: free2z's answer didn't match
mismatch.body: The reply did not match the {cost} chat request you approved for @{username}, so free2z will not open a chat. Check your 2Z balance before you try again.

uncertain.title: free2z did not get an answer
uncertain.body: free2z can't tell whether @{username} got your request or whether {cost} was charged. Trying again is safe: the same request can only be charged once.

priceChanged.title: The price changed
priceChanged.body: Starting a chat now costs {cost}. Your request was not sent at the old price, so nothing was charged. Confirm the new price to continue.

senderHandle.title: Claim your messaging handle in e2e2z first
senderHandle.body: Encrypted chats go between messaging handles, and your account doesn't have one yet, so nothing was charged. Get e2e2z, claim your handle there, then come back to message @{username}.

blocked.body: free2z prepared a request for {amount} to {creator} and holds no key to sign it. The verified link to ZUULI is not live yet, so nothing was sent.
blocked.title: ZEC tips are signed in ZUULI

declined.body: The payment was not approved in ZUULI, so nothing was sent to {creator}. Your ZEC is untouched.
declined.title: ZUULI did not authorize this tip

indeterminate.body: free2z cannot tell what happened to this {amount} tip for {creator}. Open ZUULI and check for a pending transaction before sending again.
indeterminate.title: free2z did not get an answer

unsent.body: This creator's payment details cannot be carried across the bridge, so ZUULI was never asked and nothing was sent.
unsent.title: free2z could not send this request

notFound.description: This page doesn't exist or has moved. Let's get you back on track.
notFound.title: Page not found

fund.body: Buying 2Zs still lives in ZUULI while its Zcash top-up path is separated from the card checkout. It moves to free2z next.
fund.title: Add 2Zs

failure.endedRoom: This stream has ended or is no longer accepting viewers.
failure.expiredTicket: The join ticket expired before the connection started. Try again.
failure.lifecycleRace: The stream changed while you were joining. Return to livestreams and open it again.
failure.malformedTicket: The stream server returned an invalid join ticket. Try again in a moment.
failure.offline: You're offline. Reconnect, then try again.
failure.policy: The app blocked the live connection. Check app permissions or network security settings, then try again.
failure.replayedTicket: The stream server did not issue a fresh join ticket. Try again in a moment.
failure.timeout: The live connection timed out. Try again.
failure.tokenRejected: The live service rejected this connection. Try again.
failure.transport: The live service couldn't be reached. Switch networks or try again.
failure.unknown: The live connection failed. Try again.

stage.hostRecoveryHint: Reconnect uses the existing room and will not start another stream.

zcashLinkPending.body: Linking signs a one-time challenge with your wallet key, which lives in ZUULI. A key you have already linked is shown here; link a new one from ZUULI.
zcashLinkPending.title: Linking a Zcash key happens in ZUULI
